title: The register
logline: Box 21's lid, close: the first private box, and the list he wrote on it in 2021 — dates, page counts, subjects — the register the book prints in the back, in his hand, begun.

panels.composition: Close on a cardboard lid: BOX 21 · JAN–JUN 2021 in marker, and beneath it a ruled list in pencil: dates, counts, subjects — 'no grid · 61' · 'absent · 88' · 'main street twice · 1' — the register's first page as he kept it. The pencil pressed hard. A coffee ring across the corner.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a close view of a cardboard box lid marked in black marker and beneath it a hand-ruled pencil list of dates and page counts and subjects pressed hard into the cardboard, a coffee ring across one corner, no other elements
image.notes: Letter after; the list should match the Run 7 table's counts loosely (no grid ~60, absent ~90).

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The register, begun on a lid.
